turns.text: Should I talk about raining cats and dogs kicking the bucket and turning over a leaf?
turns.zh: 我应该说「下猫下狗」「翘辫子」和「改过自新」这种习语吗？

turns.text: If you can do it really, really well?
turns.zh: 如果你能说得非常非常自然的话？

turns.text: If it fits, yeah, don't force your idioms in really phrasal verbs are another way to get idiomatic speech in, like take over.
turns.zh: 如果合适的话，对，别硬塞习语，动词短语是另一种让口语更地道的方式，比如 take over。

turns.text: So by idiomatic it means natural sound.
turns.zh: 所以「地道」的意思就是听起来自然。
